title: Hang an air nutrunner back on its spring balancer: hook through the bail, tool parked at the detent
instruction: Hang the nutrunner back on its balancer.
context: Assemblers and fabricators (BLS SOC 51-2090, miscellaneous assemblers and fabricators; 1,489,280 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) hang nutrunners and other power tools on spring balancers at every station. The balancer pulls its cable up with the tool's weight, so the tool has to be lifted to the hook, its hang bail (not the trigger guard) put over the hook, and the tool left floating at the park detent; an empty hook let go flies up into its stop. The instruction says none of this.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), heights above the bench top. Balancer: yellow housing 9 x 7 x 12 cm at x 26, y 5, 70-82 cm up, hung from a black boom on a 4 x 4 cm post at x 51. Its cable (0.3 cm) runs straight down to a black 1.4 cm swivel and the steel hook: an 0.8 cm shank 2.5 cm tall at x 26, y 5, a 0.6 x 4.8 x 0.5 cm hook bar running from it to y 0.5 with a 0.7 cm upturned tip. Hook and cable 100 g. With the cable in to its stop (a cable stop clamped on it at the housing), the hook bar's underside is 8.7 cm up; the cable pays out up to 7 cm. Spring: constant 12.1 N up (set 3% over hook plus tool). Park detent at 1.5 cm out: a 150 N/m spring within 8 mm of it. Nutrunner, 1.1 kg, unpowered (its air hose uncoupled from the inlet), lying on the bench along x, centred at x 26, y -6.4: blue body 20 x 3.6 x 3.6 cm, black 3 cm gear head with a 1.4 cm square drive at the front (+x), black 3.4 x 3 x 3 cm air inlet at the rear. Hang bail on top at the middle of the body (x 26): steel loop of 0.6 cm wire, opening 1.8 cm wide x 2.4 cm tall, facing y. Trigger guard: the same loop in orange 6 cm further forward, around a red start lever.
scoring: Through the bail: the hook bar's centre line crosses the bail's plane inside its opening (within 1.1 cm of its centre across, between the tool's back and the loop's inner top, 2 mm slack). Score 0 unless through the bail. Then 0.4; plus 0.3 hanging free: the bail's inner top within 4 mm of the hook bar's top and the tool's underside 8 mm or more above the bench; plus 0.3, with that, the cable within 6 mm of the park detent, no gripper within 2 cm of the tool or the hook (swivel, shank and bar), and hook and tool still (under 1 cm/s, 0.2 rad/s). Score 0, latched, if the hook whips up (over 1.5 m/s, or 1.2 cm in one 50 ms step, while the tool is not hanging on it: an empty hook let go), or the tool falls (faster than 0.95 m/s down, a free drop of about 5 cm, or 5 cm below the bench). Scored at the last step; 1.0 held for 1 s ends the run.
reset_notes: Take the tool off the hook (hold the hook so it does not whip up), let the hook up to its stop, lay the tool at its mark.
fidelity: Rigid boxes. The cable is a vertical slider (no swing). The constant-force spring is a soft drive re-aimed every step to pull 12.1 N; the park detent is a 150 N/m damped spring switched in within 8 mm of the park point. The cable and housing are drawn but do not collide. The hook has no safety latch.
